notes.title: Elliot Quest Re-Release - v2.0.1 Now Available
notes.content:
Elliot Quest has been rebuilt from the ground up! This latest version is the first release of the C++ rewrite, which was done so we can add new features and continue to support the game.

In honor of these updates, and to thank the Steam community who have supported the game, we're discounting Elliot Quest by 25%. (Next week we will be raising the price to $14.99)

These updates are only for the PC build. Mac & Linux updates should be coming at some point in the future.

- Adds multiple save slots
- Adds Steam achievements
- Adds Steam Cloud Saves
- Adds Full controller support + multiple control modes (choose between 4 modes on the title screen)
- Adds Localization: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Japanese
- Adds new hidden collectibles and a secret area (paintings from the console version)
- Lots of performance optimizations
- Lots of bug fixes
- Removes Windows XP support

*IMPORTANT* Unfortunately your existing save data will not work with the updated version. We are currently working on a tool that will export and convert the save data from the old version, which we are expecting to finish in about a month.

notes.title: Re-release announcement - big updates coming May 8th
notes.content:
Hello!

I'm excited to introduce myself! I'm with PlayEveryWare, and we've been working with Ansimuz Games to develop a C++ version of Elliot Quest. We've rebuilt the game from scratch so that we can bring it to consoles (which we just announced) as well as further support the game on Steam!

Some of the new features that will come with this update on Steam:
- Multiple save slots
- Steam achievements
- Steam Cloud Saves
- Full controller support + multiple control modes
- Localization: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Japanese
- New hidden collectibles

We plan to release this update on Steam on May 8th. There may be some updates on the product page in the meantime, showing the new features - but they won't actually be available until the update is released on Monday.

With all of this, we feel like it's fair to update the price of the game to $14.99. However, we won't be starting that until May 15th. Until then, we will be discounting the game by 25% of it's current price (so $7.49 USD) once the update is released.

There are two other important notes for this update to know about:
- This C++ rewrite of the game does not currently support Mac or Linux. The current plan is to update the engine to support Mac near the end of summer, and Linux sometime after that.
- Existing save data is not yet supported. We are currently working on a conversion tool that will extract and convert the original save data.

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Elliot Quest Update. v.1.1.0 available
notes.content:
Elliot Quest been online for a week now and been listening to players feedback all this time. 

I made a major update addressing most of the critical issues and suggested  improvements:

[list]
[*] Added fullscreen option in the settings
[*] Added possibility to toggle gamepad by pressing "G" in keyboard
[*] Added warning message to prevent overwriting saved data on new game
[*] Fixed Coliseum issues 
[*] Fixed unlimited bomb bags for sale glitch
[*] Fixed camera focus lost on activating pedestals with statues
[*] Player will die if squashed by doors now
[*] Run faster perk is now working correctly
[*] Level cap to 20 is fixed now
[*] Fixed unreachable ladder in the caves bug
[*] You cannot fall accidentally at the dessert cliff in the map   
[*] Balanced extreme mode difficulty
[*] Fixed Dead ends for waterfalls
[*] Added  more random encounters
[/list]
